1981-2415-3188-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

529-3197-6791-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2506-3249-4549--52.easyPrerequisites: The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2506-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5268-6887--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3286-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
3286-4687-4929.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-4694-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4552-4694-7803.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

338-1379-2685-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1379-2685-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3291-6633.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-6633.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2173-4496-4699-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1682-2366-4478-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-4478-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2438-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

465-3175-5147.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1997-7271.description: Maralen prevents players from drawing, but allows tutors, Mindlock Orb prevents players from tutoring

791-3693-5427-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5427-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

2231-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1308-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

250-779-1315-1479-6529.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-6529.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2916-3381-5856.easyPrerequisites:
Morgue Toad exiled by Hazel's Brewmaster.
You control a Food.
2916-3381-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food token.
Activate the Food tapped in step 1 using Morgue Toad's ability by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

3923-5195-6259.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

851-2079-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

719-1238-2351-5256-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

1182-4934-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Stonecoil Serpent from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

802-4191-4217.easyPrerequisites: There is an applicable target for Snap.
802-4191-4217.description:
Cast Snap by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Lutri without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Snap.
Resolve the Snap copy, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-2034-2433.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2034-2433.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Pentavite tokens.

2034-2832-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brine Comber, adding {C}{C}.
Brine Comber dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Brine Comber from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Brine Comber enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3101-3327-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Dargo for {R}.
3101-3327-5147.description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-3518-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3518-5131.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1369-3814-5137.notablePrerequisites: Two lands that tap for blue.
1369-3814-5137.description:
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Morphling.
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Argothian Elder.
Tap Quicksilver Elemental for at least {C}{U}.
Pay {U} to untap Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat.

790-1218-1972.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1218-1972.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Nekusar infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
